name: Azerbaijan Grand Prix
sources_2026_10_02: Race-story notes added from formula1.com (race report + Norris reaction), Sky Sports, Crash.net (results after penalties), Pit Debrief and the McLaren race report, all 2026-09-26. Where sources disagreed on a lap or corner number (Albon's crash, Stroll's stop) the note omits the number rather than pick one.
summary: George Russell converted pole into his third win of the season, holding off Max Verstappen by 0.196s in a race reset by two Safety Cars. Alex Albon's crash brought out the first; at the restart Franco Colapinto locked up into Turn 1 and took out team mate Pierre Gasly and Lando Norris. Isack Hadjar took third on his return from injury, Kimi Antonelli recovered from P16 to P5, and Oscar Piastri fell from the podium places to P13 after a late lock-up. Seven cars failed to finish, including both Aston Martins with technical problems; Valtteri Bottas crashed on the final lap but was classified P16. Gabriel Bortoleto's post-race 10-second penalty dropped him from P13 to P15.

classification.stewardNote: Pole, win and fastest lap. Led from the start, controlled both Safety Car restarts, and held on after Bottas's last-lap crash forced him to lift under yellows and cost him deployment.
+0.196s. Up from P8 to third inside seven laps, passed Piastri at the first restart, then pulled alongside Russell on the run to the flag and missed his first win of 2026 by two tenths.
+10.704s. Podium on his return from the wrist injury that kept him out of the previous three rounds.
+14.136s. Lost second to Piastri at the start; held off a closing Antonelli by under four tenths at the flag.
+14.512s. Started P16 after hitting the wall in qualifying and dropped a place on lap one. Worked into the points, narrowly avoided the Turn 1 restart crash, and passed Hamilton on lap 42.
+22.382s. Passed Norris early; struggled in the final stint and lost fifth to Antonelli.
+31.159s. Snatched seventh from Ocon at the end, by three hundredths.
+31.189s. Passed team mate Bearman into Turn 2 just before the second Safety Car.
+32.416s. Qualified 9th; a grid penalty dropped him to P14. Recovered to the final point.
Back at Racing Bulls after three rounds deputising for Hadjar at Red Bull.

Up to P2 at the start and ran there until the first restart, when cold Mediums cost him a place to Verstappen. Later locked up into Turn 1 defending from Hadjar, flat-spotted his tyres and fell out of the points.
Received a 10-second post-race penalty for overtaking under yellow flags; the penalty dropped him from P13 to P15.
Hit the wall at Turn 15 on the final lap; the yellows nearly handed Verstappen the win. Classified P16 after completing 49 laps; the official result records DNF.
Collision. Locked up into Turn 1 at the first Safety Car restart and slid into team mate Gasly, who was knocked into Norris. All three retired; Colapinto called it "a big mistake."
Collision. Running in the points when team mate Colapinto hit him into Turn 1 at the restart, pushing him into Norris.

Collision. Short on straight-line speed, he dropped to P7 and then flat-spotted his tyres in a lock-up, pitting as the Safety Car came out. Was gaining at the restart when the Alpine collision sent him into the Turn 1 barrier. Afterwards: "some drivers shouldn't be in F1."
Crash. Locked up and went into the barrier around lap 30, bringing out the first Safety Car.
Technical. Retired in the pits with a car problem unrelated to his team mate's, making it a double Aston Martin DNF.
Technical. First retirement of the race: the team told him to stop with a water pressure issue in the opening laps, and he parked safely without needing a neutralisation.
